title: Beethoven: the same exposition twice
question: What differs when the score changes nothing?
intro: The repeat sign sends bars 1–124 back to bar 1 with the same notes, instruments and written markings. This is the control: two passes through one exposition in the same recording, not the later recapitulation. Timing is aligned automatically, not checked by ear; measured differences are provisional and do not establish intention.
listenFor: Compare the lengths of the opening pauses and the relative level of the quieter second tune, without treating a measured difference as a written change.

sources.title: Mutopia 941: Beethoven, Symphony No. 5, first movement — Breitkopf and Härtel, 1862–65
LilyPond orchestral sources: every part encloses bars 1–124 in the same two-pass repeat, with no alternative ending
